art_direction: 浅燕麦底，斜向错位双眼瞥向左上，像递来一个小暗号。
composition_variation: Gentle diagonal descending right. Higher left has broad lid and medium opening; lower right a shallower sweeping opening. Both pupils look upper-left with a single long slim ivory glint each. Right outer corner lifts to echo the left lid curve, creating rhythm without symmetry. A subtle playful signal, smart and light, never sinister.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
